notes.title: 1.31 out now
notes.content:
We have fixed three minor bugs.

- The last story in the new DLC did not work if you were on story 5 in the main game. (A weird bug that probably only a few of you have experienced).
- If you played DLC 1 before playing DLC 2 (without shutting down the game), an incorrect interview was playing on the radio.
- A wrong sound would play when you pressed B on a controller when you were on the cameras.

notes.title: A real horror researcher is in the first free DLC!
notes.content:
We can now reveal the last horror expert that is part of the first free DLC for the game (Stories by horror experts)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981917/e78766ebf8c7a9d4e82792567d99589f90359ab3.jpg[/img]
[b]Mathias Clasen[/b] is a horror researcher at Aarhus University. He is the author of “Why Horror Seduces” and “A Very Nervous Person's Guide to Horror Movies”. He will be on the radio in the game where he will answer questions like: Is a horror film a good date film? What are the positive effects of playing horror games? And many other thrilling things he has learned through his research.

Stories by horror experts will be released on [b]14 January[/b]. Have you remembered to [b]Wishlist [/b]it?

The DLC will feature stories by:
[b]ManlyBadassHero - Alpha Beta Gamer - The Mason Scale[/b]

Otherwise, happy new year to you all!
- John & Maria

notes.title: New bug in previous update is fixed!
notes.content:
In the previous update, a new game breaking bug had been added that corrupted story 8 in the game. It is now fixed!

We've had to change how the game handles part of the game in order to make one of the stories from one of the horror experts for the first free DLC. It is this change that caused the new bug, which should be fixed now. We are doing additional testing to be sure, but didn't want to wait with the update as this bug could ruin the experience for some.

notes.title: Security: The Horrible Nights - First week!
notes.content:
[b]Security: The Horrible Nights[/b] has now been out for a week, and a lot has happened!
It's been a crazy week! We want to share what has happened, what’s going to happen, and say thank you.

We're thrilled to hear that many of you have enjoyed the game! That’s why we make games. :)
Thanks to everyone who reviewed the game, and a special thank you to those who mentioned in your reviews which story you liked best—because we’re curious. Thanks also to everyone who has shared the game with others. It’s tough to get noticed as a small indie developer, so we deeply appreciate your support. <3

[b]The game is now version 1.10[/b]

We believe we’ve fixed the bugs you’ve reported. Thank you for your feedback! (And we’re ready to fix more if you encounter any!)

We’ve been watching, listening, and reading about your experiences with the game, and based on that, we’ve made several small adjustments and additions to improve the experience. Some examples include:

•	You can now also hold down SHIFT to run.
•	Instead of needing to hold the run button for 5 seconds to run extra fast, you now only need to hold it for 3 seconds.
•	We’ve clarified certain things/events that some players missed.
•	SPOILER: [spoiler]We’ve made your patients behind the red door move 20% faster.[/spoiler]

[b]Other interesting things that have happened[/b]

•	Over 4000 stories have been survived!
•	Boshea has created The Security Survival Guide, so help is now always within reach! (Find it under Guides here on Steam.)
•	We still haven’t seen anyone steal a drink from the boss’s minibar in his office. (You’re obviously very well-behaved.)
	
[b]What happens next?[/b]
We’ll, of course, continue fixing bugs reported in the bug thread here on Steam.

The soundtrack for the game will be released in a week!

We’re also working on the first free DLC, featuring stories by horror experts. We’ll be interviewing Mathias Clasen, a horror researcher at Aarhus University and author of A Very Nervous Person's Guide to Horror Movies, which explores research on how horror affects us. Interestingly, there are many positive effects of experiencing horror. Be sure to wishlist the DLC to get notified when it releases early next year.

The second free DLC will feature stories based on fan ideas. If you have a horror story idea you’d like to see in the game, there’s a link here to submit it for consideration.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2911390/discussions/0/4514379280323767599/


Otherwise, enjoy your work as a security guard!
- John & Maria
Professional Villains

notes.title: 70 fans' ideas turned into 4 stories!
notes.content:
We've read through over 500 horror ideas from you through our Discord, the game's Steam page, and Manly Badass Hero's video playing the demo.

We selected over 70 ideas and turned them into 4 unique horror stories. You can try them out now in the free prologue called Security: Stories by the fans:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199440/Security_Stories_by_the_fans/?l=danish&curator_clanid=40000720]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199440/Security_Stories_by_the_fans/?l=danish&curator_clanid=40000720[/url]

If you play the 4 stories, be sure to write a Steam review mentioning which one of the 4 is your favorite. Because we're super curious to hear which one people like the best! :D

We will make more stories based on fan ideas. There are several here on the game's Steam page that we already really like and would love to do that we couldn’t fit in the prologue. So, it's still possible for you to get your idea into the game! You have the best chance of getting your idea included if you answer the questions in this thread:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2911390/discussions/0/4514379280323767599/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2911390/discussions/0/4514379280323767599/[/url]

Short, precise ideas are more likely to be included than long, detailed descriptions.

We will make a free DLC with more stories based on fan ideas after we release Security: The Horrible Nights in November. The more wishlists we have, the more additional stories we can make. So, remember to wishlist the game and maybe get a friend to do the same. ;)

It's been both fun and challenging to create the four stories based on fan ideas. We can't wait to read what else you come up with!
- John & Maria
Professional Villains

notes.title: Free prologue based on fans' ideas!
notes.content:
We've had so many great ideas for the fan DLC already that we've decided to make a free prologue for Security: The Horrible Nights.

The free prologue is called Security: Stories by the fans, and will be a standalone game. You can already wistlist it now to be notified when it is released:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199440/Security_Stories_by_the_fans/?l=english]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199440/Security_Stories_by_the_fans/?l=english[/url]

We will still make a free DLC based on fan ideas after the main game is released. So, we've saved the ideas we didn't use in the prologue, and you can still post your ideas in the thread here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2911390/discussions/0/4514379280323767599/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2911390/discussions/0/4514379280323767599/[/url]

It's been fun reading your ideas and making some of them. We look forward to reading more ideas and making more of them!
- John & Maria
